address: 10 Berkeley Square, Mayfair, London, W1J 6BR, United Kingdom
bio: There is a tremendous sense of flair to this sexy, stylish restaurant with a party atmosphere. The glowing, flaming grills are an immediate eye-catcher, as is the jungle-inspired décor that combines with live music to make this the perfect place not just for a meal, but for a proper night out. Quality ingredients power the roster of South American dishes from tiraditos to tequeños. There's a small sushi selection available too, from the playfully named 'Japazonico' menu....
